Official Detail: Standing start completed. Green flag racing underway across all sectors.
Car 31 entered pit lane with hydraulic leak. Confirmed retirement.
Car 20 stopped on track with power unit smoke and fire. Marshals deployed with extinguishers.
Virtual Safety Car deployed to allow recovery vehicle entry for Car 20. Delta time enforced.
Physical Safety Car deployed due to track contamination and heavy recovery crane on Wellington Straight.
Track clear. All debris recovered. Safety Car lights out, entering pit lane at end of lap 39.
Green flag racing resumed at start/finish line. DRS enabled on lap 42.
Car 10 suffered right rear suspension failure following turn 16 contact with Car 18. Pitted and retired.
Car 18 (Stroll) penalized 5 seconds added to elapsed race time for causing a collision with Car 10 at Turn 16.
52 laps completed. Winner: Car 1 (Verstappen), P2: Car 4 (Norris), P3: Car 44 (Hamilton).
